statement: Integer multiplication below $`n\log n`$. Multiplies two n-bit integers exactly at every input length in deterministic worst-case time $`O(n(\log n)^{1-\kappa})`$, with $`\kappa=2^{-182}`$, on one fixed finite-alphabet Turing machine with finitely many one-dimensional tapes. This disproves the Schönhage–Strassen $`n\log n`$ optimality conjecture in the ordinary multitape bit model.
